newsitem.title: USA: ComEd shuts LaSalle 1 Ill. power plant.
newsitem.headline: ComEd shuts LaSalle 1 Ill. power plant.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co shut its 1,078 megawatt (MW) LaSalle 1 nuclear power plant for repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reported Monday.
The unit, in Seneca, Ill., was expected to come back on line some time later today, according to the NRC report.
The unscheduled outage, reported to the NRC Sunday, was blamed on problems with a turbine control valve.
The neighboring LaSalle 2 reactor, also rated at 1,078 MW, was shut for planned maintenance Friday.
